sql: begin read only; set local statement_timeout='30s'; select * from ash.status(); select * from ash.aas(since=>'2026-10-21 21:54+00',until=>'2026-10-21 21:59+00'); select * from ash.timeline(since=>'2026-10-21 21:54+00',until=>'2026-10-21 21:59+00'); commit;

begin read only; set local statement_timeout='30s'; select * from ash.top('wait_event',since=>'2026-10-21 21:57+00',until=>'2026-10-21 21:59+00'); select * from ash.timeline(since=>'2026-10-21 21:57+00',until=>'2026-10-21 21:59+00',bucket=>'1 second'); select * from ash.samples(since=>'2026-10-21 21:57+00',until=>'2026-10-21 21:59+00',n=>10); commit;

begin read only; set local statement_timeout='30s'; select * from ash.top('query_id',since=>'2026-10-21 21:57+00',until=>'2026-10-21 21:59+00',wait_event=>'Lock:transactionid'); select * from ash.samples(since=>'2026-10-21 21:57+00',until=>'2026-10-21 21:59+00',n=>12); select * from ash.aas(since=>'2026-10-21 21:55+00',until=>'2026-10-21 21:57+00'); commit;

begin read only; set local statement_timeout='30s'; select wait_event, query_id, min(sample_time) as first_seen, max(sample_time) as last_seen, count(*) as observations, count(distinct sample_time) as ticks from ash.samples(since=>'2026-10-21 21:57+00',until=>'2026-10-21 21:59+00',n=>1000) group by 1,2 order by observations desc; select * from ash.top('wait_event',since=>'2026-10-21 21:57+00',until=>'2026-10-21 21:59+00',query_id=>-1016721775295826782); select * from ash.aas(since=>'2026-10-21 21:57+00',until=>'2026-10-21 21:59+00'); select pid,datname,state,wait_event_type,wait_event,pg_blocking_pids(pid) as blockers from pg_stat_activity where datname='appdb'; commit;

begin read only; set local statement_timeout='30s'; with ticks as (select sample_time,count(*) as backends from ash.samples(since=>'2026-10-21 21:57+00',until=>'2026-10-21 21:59+00',n=>1000) group by 1), gaps as (select *, sample_time-lag(sample_time) over(order by sample_time) as gap from ticks) select * from gaps order by sample_time; commit;
